title: Occult history in NASA and launch pad choices

tellings.quote: There's a lot of occult history, occult history in NASA. Some of the the nomenclature that was used for certain missions and and the choosing of, you know, launch pad 33 and some other things were very deliberate.

plain: NASA, the US space agency, is said to have a lot of hidden occult history, with some mission names and the choice of launch pad 33 picked on purpose for symbolic reasons. An unnamed guest says this on an episode featuring a guest known as RedPandaKoala, calling those choices "very deliberate."
